Our Foundation

About The Academy

Where Indian tradition meets Olympic-grade discipline.

8+
Years Legacy

Our Story

MAATRABHUMI Martial Art Academy & Sports Foundation was founded on a simple belief — that true strength is built from the soil of one's own values. What began as a single training ground has grown into a nationally recognised institution shaping disciplined athletes and responsible citizens.

Mission

To deliver world-class martial arts and fitness education rooted in Indian heritage, cultivating discipline, respect and resilience in every student we train.

Vision

To stand among the nation's most respected martial arts institutions — producing champions for the podium and citizens of exceptional character.

Core Values

Discipline

Structured routine shaping every student's daily practice.

Respect

Honouring instructors, peers and the tradition itself.

Character

Building citizens of integrity, on and off the mat.

Dedication

Consistent effort in service of self and nation.

What We Teach

Our Programs

Eight disciplines, one philosophy of excellence.

Karate

Traditional striking, forms and sparring across all belt levels.

Self Defence

Practical, real-world techniques for personal protection.

Fitness

Strength and conditioning built for martial performance.

Women's Safety

Dedicated self-defence programs for women of all ages.

Kids Classes

Fun, age-appropriate training that builds focus early.

Tournament Training

Focused coaching for state, national & international events.

Weapons Training

Traditional weapon forms taught under strict supervision.

Meditation

Mental conditioning to build focus, calm and clarity.
